papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence, encompassing 3D perception and reasoning, is the essential next frontier of AI. Scaling current 3D vision-language models (VLMs) that rely on dense Transformers for spatial tasks incurs prohibitive computational costs. In this paper, we introduce 3D-MoE, a 3D VLM leveraging an efficient mixture-of-experts architecture with a modality- and spatial-context-aware probabilistic routing scheme, stably cultivated by a novel routing curriculum. To seamlessly extend 3D-MoE to embodied AI, we integrate a diffusion-based action head, Pose-DiT, transforming 3D-MoE into a 3D vision-language-action (VLA) model. By employing a rectified flow framework, Pose-DiT generates precise 6D pose actions in a single sampling step. Extensive experiments demonstrate that 3D-MoE achieves superior performance on diverse 3D vision-language benchmarks with drastically fewer activated parameters and yields higher success rates while enabling real-time inference for robot manipulation tasks.

analysis.key_results: 3D-MoE在多个3D视觉语言基准上以更少的激活参数获得更优性能，并在机器人操作任务中取得更高成功率且实现实时推理。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出3D-MoE，一种利用高效专家混合架构和模态与空间上下文感知的概率路由方案的3D视觉语言模型，并通过路由课程稳定训练；进而引入基于扩散的动作头Pose-DiT，将其扩展为3D视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，采用整流流框架实现单步采样生成精确6D位姿动作。
analysis.method: 采用专家混合（MoE）架构，结合模态与空间上下文感知的概率路由方案和路由课程；扩散动作头Pose-DiT使用整流流框架进行单步采样生成动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于专家混合架构的3D视觉语言模型3D-MoE，并通过扩散动作头扩展为3D视觉语言动作模型，实现高效3D推理与实时机器人操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接扩展为3D视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，面向机器人操作任务，与本站VLA主题高度相关；其中的专家混合架构与高效路由属于高效推理技术，可用于后续VLA/WAM的轻量化部署。

figures.caption: 3D-MoE accommodates 3D visual inputs and either generates textual responses for various 3D vision-language tasks—such as 3D scene captioning and 3D question answering—or predicts 6D poses for embodied tasks using the Pose-DiT action diffusion module. “Vision Embed” and “Lang Embed” refer to vision (blue) and language (purple) embeddings, respectively.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Architecture of 3D-MoE and routing curriculum in a three-stage training pipeline. In Stage I, we pretrain the vision modules and apply our proposed routing curriculum to warm-start 3D-MoE. In Stage II, we finetune 3D-MoE on 3D vision-language tasks. In Stage III, we integrate the Pose-DiT action head, enabling 3D-MoE to predict 6D pose actions for embodied tasks. ⊕ \oplus denotes a weighted average.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: 3D-MoE: Towards Spatial Intelligence with Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Reasoning and Action Generation
papers.title_zh: 3D-MoE：面向空间智能的专家混合模型，用于3D推理与动作生成
